name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 25 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-08-07, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.83 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
